Public Attendance at Council Meetings
Council meetings are currently open to public attendance, however attendance limits may still be considered due to Council’s Workplace Health & Safety obligations. It is recommended that members of the public wishing to attend a Council meeting RSVP prior to each meeting by calling Council on 6491 0200.
Can't attend in person?   Join the meeting via the live stream link here:
Kentish Council Meeting - 23 September 2026
YouTube Link for Meeting Recordings: Kentish Council Channel
2026 Council Meeting Dates
Meetings are usually held on the third Wednesday of the month, commencing at 6 pm in the Kentish Council Chambers unless stated otherwise.
  • January 21
  • February 18
  • March 18
  • April 22 (fourth Wednesday)
  • May 4 - Special Council Meeting
  • May 20
  • June 17
  • July 22 (fourth Wednesday)
  • August 18 (third Tuesday)
  • September 23 (fourth Wednesday)
  • October 21
  • November 18
  • December 16
At each Council meeting up to 15 minutes will be provided at a time determined by the Chairperson for any person present at the meeting (other than a Councillor) to ask questions or address the Council on a Council related issue.  Please click here to view Council's policy on public participation at Council meetings.
The agenda will be available for perusal on the Council website prior to the meeting.
Council Minutes
The Local Government Act 1993 (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13) requires a Council's General Manager to record the minutes for every Council meeting.
The Act (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13 Sub-paragraph (2)) allows the General Manager to only record in the minutes that a matter was discussed in "closed" session and to not record details of the matter unless Council determines otherwise.
As soon as practicable but at least at the next ordinary meeting, minutes are to be circulated to all councillors and are to be confirmed as a true record at the next ordinary meeting by motion of a council or council committee.

Public Attendance at Council Meetings
Council meetings are currently open to public attendance, however attendance limits may still be considered due to Council’s Workplace Health & Safety obligations. It is recommended that members of the public wishing to attend a Council meeting RSVP prior to each meeting by calling Council on 6491 0200.
Can't attend in person?   Join the meeting via the live stream link here:
Kentish Council Meeting - 23 September 2026
YouTube Link for Meeting Recordings: Kentish Council Channel
2026 Council Meeting Dates
Meetings are usually held on the third Wednesday of the month, commencing at 6 pm in the Kentish Council Chambers unless stated otherwise.
  • January 21
  • February 18
  • March 18
  • April 22 (fourth Wednesday)
  • May 4 - Special Council Meeting
  • May 20
  • June 17
  • July 22 (fourth Wednesday)
  • August 18 (third Tuesday)
  • September 23 (fourth Wednesday)
  • October 21
  • November 18
  • December 16
At each Council meeting up to 15 minutes will be provided at a time determined by the Chairperson for any person present at the meeting (other than a Councillor) to ask questions or address the Council on a Council related issue.  Please click here to view Council's policy on public participation at Council meetings.
The agenda will be available for perusal on the Council website prior to the meeting.
Council Minutes
The Local Government Act 1993 (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13) requires a Council's General Manager to record the minutes for every Council meeting.
The Act (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13 Sub-paragraph (2)) allows the General Manager to only record in the minutes that a matter was discussed in "closed" session and to not record details of the matter unless Council determines otherwise.
As soon as practicable but at least at the next ordinary meeting, minutes are to be circulated to all councillors and are to be confirmed as a true record at the next ordinary meeting by motion of a council or council committee.
